content:
# Testament of Zebulun — 6
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Cantabrigiensis) | **Section:** Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs

---

1:1 The-copy-of-the-words of-Zebulun, which-he-enjoined-upon-his-sons before-he-died in-the-hundred-and-fourteenth-year-of-his-life.
1:2 And-he-said-to-them: Hear-me, ye-sons-of-Zebulun, attend-to-the-words-of-your-father.
1:3 I, Zebulun, was-a-good-gift to-my-parents, for-when I-was-born my-father-was-increased-in-flocks-and-herds, for-during-the-time-that-my-mother-was-bearing-me-he-was-increased in-everything-both-in-the-possession-of-cattle-and-in-fields.
1:4 I-am-not-conscious-that-I-have-sinned-all-my-days, save-in-thought.
1:5 Nor-do-I-remember-that-I-have-done-any-iniquity, except-the-sin-of-ignorance-which-I-committed-against-Joseph; for-I-covenanted-with-my-brethren-not-to-tell-my-father-what-had-been-done-to-Joseph.
1:6 But I-wept-in-secret many-days-because-of-him; for-I-feared-my-brethren, because-they-had-all-agreed-that-if-any-one-should-declare-the-secret, he-should-be-slain.
1:7 But-when-they-wished-to-kill-him, I-adjured-them-with-many-tears-not-to-be-guilty-of-this-sin.

2:1 For-Simeon-and-Gad came-against-Joseph-to-kill-him, and-he-said-to-them-with-tears:
2:2 Pity-me, my-brethren, have-mercy-on-the-bowels-of-Jacob-our-father: lay-not-your-hands-on-me-to-shed-innocent-blood, for-I-have-not-sinned-against-you.
2:3 And-if-I-have-indeed-sinned, chastise-me-with-discipline, but-lay-not-upon-me-your-hands, for-the-sake-of-our-father Jacob.
2:4 And-as-he-spoke-these-words, weeping-the-while, I-was-unable-to-bear-his-lamentations, and-I-began-also-to-weep, and-my-liver-was-poured-out, and-all-the-substance-of-my-bowels-was-loosened.
2:5 And-Joseph-wept, and I-wept-with-him; and-the-whole-earth-trembled-at-his-voice.
2:6 And I-stood-up-against-my-brethren-and-said: We-will-not-slay-him, but-let-us-cast-him-into-one-of-these-dry-pits, which-our-fathers-digged-and-found-no-water-in; for-God-forbid-that-we-should-destroy-our-brother.

3:1 And-Simeon-and-Gad-laid-hold-of-Joseph-to-kill-him; and-I-fell-on-my-face-before-their-feet-entreating-them-on-behalf-of-Joseph.
3:2 And-Simeon-said-to-me: What-is-this-that-thou-intercedest-for-him? He-also-came-to-Dothan to-spy-on-our-doings.
3:3 And-Judah-having-taken-him-away from-them according-to-the-word-of-our-father Jacob, the-Midianites came-while-Judah-was-absent and-drew-up-Joseph-out-of-the-pit; and-sold-Joseph-to-the-Ishmaelites for-twenty-pieces-of-gold.
3:4 And-our-brothers-were-ashamed-and-came-and-told-our-father that-a-wild-beast-had-devoured-Joseph; and-they-brought-a-kid and-dipped-his-coat in-its-blood.

4:1 And-after-this I-had-great-suffering-and-grief; for-I-mourned-over-Joseph-for-a-long-time.
4:2 But-I-had-pity-on-the-poor-and-sick and-on-all-who-needed-anything.
4:3 For-all-these-things, my-children, I-was-stirred-up-in-my-heart, and-I-had-compassion-for-every-man's-condition.
4:4 Neither-was-a-hungry-man-unknown-to-me, nor-a-naked-man; but I-gave-something-from-my-goods-to-everyone-who-needed-anything.
4:5 And-now-I-say-to-you, my-children, love-the-LORD with-all-your-strength, and-love-one-another in-truth-of-heart.

5:1 For-I-perceive-that-through-the-hardness-of-your-hearts-all-wickedness-has-its-birth.
5:2 For-he-that-is-merciful-and-poor, if-he-be-not-compassionate-to-every-one, in-his-poverty-shall-he-have-no-hope-before-God.
5:3 For-through-compassion-of-heart-a-man-is-rich-before-God, though-he-be-poor-in-goods; but-through-hardness-of-heart-though-he-have-much-gold-he-is-poor-before-God.
5:4 If-I-had-lain-in-a-dry-place I-had-lived; but-I-was-moved-to-compassion-even-for-the-least-of-my-brethren.
5:5 And-now, my-sons, I-bid-you have-compassion-upon-every-man-with-mercy, that-the-LORD-also-may-have-compassion-and-mercy-upon-you.
5:6 For-in-the-last-days God-will-send-his-compassion-on-the-earth, and-wheresoever-he-finds-bowels-of-mercy-he-dwells-in-him.

6:1 For-to-what-extent-a-man-has-compassion-on-his-neighbours, to-that-extent-has-the-LORD-also-upon-him.
6:2 For-when-we-went-down-into-Egypt, Joseph-bore-no-malice-against-us.
6:3 To-whom-then-should-ye-take-heed but-to-God, who-made-heaven-and-earth and-set-the-limits-of-life-of-man?
6:4 Have-compassion-therefore-on-your-neighbours, and-be-not-unfeeling-toward-strangers-and-the-poor.
6:5 For-wheresoever-a-man-turns-himself, the-soul-that-is-given-to-God-in-mercy-shall-always-find-a-dwelling-place.

7:1 And-when-Zebulun-had-said-these-things, he-fell-asleep in-a-good-old-age.
7:2 And-his-sons-did-as-he-had-bidden-them, and-they-carried-him-away and-buried-him-in-Hebron with-his-fathers.

---
*End of Testament of Zebulun*
